column1: # Stage S8 V4 — the browser half of the map engine's streaming becomes two streaming crates: the loaders folder
# (the world and occluder loaders and the asset sink handle) becomes map_asset_loading with its module root
# that crate's root, joined by the asset statistics, the live memory budget, the world's elevation, water,
# relief, satellite, forest and label loaders and the CPU mesh composition with its tests; the host folder
# becomes map_streaming_host with its module root that crate's root, its files under names that say what they
# hold; the streaming documentation moves to the mirror of the streaming crates. Paths name the tree before
# the moves; the map engine keeps re-export shims at its streaming module paths until the stage switch.
# the world and occluder loaders, the asset sink handle, the asset statistics and the live memory budget
# the world's terrain and environment loaders, the satellite loads and the CPU mesh composition
# the map host: boot, host state, camera settle, layer switches and queries
# the streaming documentation into the mirror of the streaming crates
